final_manifest.status_rule: The manifest and all data remain review-pending until exact fragment commits and aggregate review are accepted.

identity_rules: Every fragment must identify the fixed input commit 542349e2f70ec9883d743594f906ac6c4e96ba5a and source boundary 1d6ee92adf6ccca38eeee64b1371cba1497e8fcd.
Every artifact path must resolve in the candidate and its SHA-256 must match the exact reviewed output commit.
Every source record must preserve repository-relative path, source commit, SHA-256, and exact line or line-range identity.
Every public API row must distinguish its canonical fully qualified public path from its actual definition owner and preserve cfg attributes and features.
Every package and manifest must retain a unique workspace identity; equal package names in separate workspaces remain separate records.
Every component WID must preserve its ID and name, actual definition source, task owner, and each public re-export path as a separate destination record.
Every historical row must preserve its original row identity and source bytes. It is a requirement or provenance record, not an active test.
Foundation package rows include package_id, manifest_path, normalized_package_identity, and metadata source identity; publisher packages with equal names remain distinct by workspace package ID.
Historical API rows separate source_api_identity, cleanup_attachment, and current_binding, and report explicit resolution status instead of inferring a current owner from a leaf symbol.

components.preservation: W01-W45 remain present without ID reuse. Add all required omitted component IDs from the accepted source fragment.

routes.preservation: Keep target tag, live Page object, dispatch path, factory, definition owner, and planned content owner separate.
routes.owner_task_binding: Join route.requirement_id to the app-routes requirements array by id; preserve current route owner and planned content owner as separate fields.

public_exports.source: all fragment export and item records
public_exports.preservation: Deduplicate the index without flattening nested module paths. Preserve every distinct path and all source provenance.

input_fields.foundation: Items retain package_id, source package, definition package, canonical definition_owner, public_qualified_paths, exact source path/line/hash, and cfg attributes/features; export rows retain canonical destination paths and source-package identity.
input_fields.components: items.qualified_symbol, items.definition_symbol, items.source, items.line_start, items.sha256, cfg, reachability_paths; exports.expanded_public_paths and expanded_symbols
input_fields.applications: items.declared_public_types_aliases_states_actions, exports public_root_modules/public_root_reexports, route/API source refs where exported

requirements.source: all fragment requirements and history migration items
requirements.retire_rule: RETIRE requires a specific conflict or replacement plus a matching independent decision whose source, artifact, symbol scope, and cleanup scope agree.
requirements.unresolved_rule: Every unresolved row names a task and blocks final completion.

input_fields.foundation: requirements.id, named_owner_task, disposition, source, proposed_required_cases, evidence_state; historical_api_dispositions preserve source_api_identity, cleanup_attachment record/path/hash, current_binding and resolution status.
input_fields.components: requirements.requirement_id, named_owner_task, disposition, current_source, proposed_required_cases, evidence
input_fields.applications: requirements.id, task, source_refs, proposed_required_cases, case_status, evidence
input_fields.history: Migration items use item_id, historical_source, original_claim, current_sources, owner_task, disposition, disposition_reason, required_case, evidence, and block_final. Historical coverage rows use row_id and current_mapping.

historical_coverage.rule: Validate every JSONL row, exact data hash, stable key, source identity, lane and disposition total. Do not copy all rows into requirements.json.

source_binding.historical_source: Commit, repository-relative path, physical line, raw line text, line SHA-256, full file SHA-256, and preserved T00 location.
source_binding.historical_claim: Original symbol/claim, reason, exact raw text, catalogue locator/span hash, and claim kind.
source_binding.join_key: Stable row_id. Preserve each original allowlist line, including duplicate source text at different line numbers.

policy_contract.keys_and_types: Preserve the six existing keys and their JSON types. Keep full API inventory detail in requirements.json.

ownership_compatibility.previous_proposal_rule: Preserve the original proposal owner values, source path, and hash inside requirements.json. Current component ownership fields name actual definition owners and keep re-exports separate.

migration_document_rule.claim_rule: All commit-pinned test links are historical. Do not describe removed tests or conformance targets as current.

required_historical_items.additional_application_and_review_decisi: All migration item records emitted by the accepted history fragment; keep each item ID distinct.

controls.mutation: Remove one Button/W02 canonical public path from a copied export index; keep the linked requirement disposition KEEP.
controls.expected: The validator reports that the required current public path is absent and exits nonzero.

controls.mutation: Change only the copied Button/W02 row to RETIRE without a matching source-bound independent decision.
controls.expected: The validator continues to reject the missing Button path.

controls.mutation: Attach the accepted runtime::stub T37 decision to Button/W02.
controls.expected: The validator rejects the mismatch between the decision's symbol/removal scope and Button.

controls.mutation: Change the copied runtime::stub row to KEEP although the fixed product source has no current export.
controls.expected: The validator reports the missing required current export.

controls.mutation: Restore the copied runtime::stub row to its exact source-bound RETIRE disposition and T37-FOUNDATION-TESTING-03 decision.
controls.expected: The validator discharges only the runtime::stub expectation.

missing_export_control.mutation_scope: In-memory copies only. Keep product source, original migration rows, and all source-bound artifacts byte-identical.

checks: Verify each fragment commit and artifact SHA against the manifest.
Verify each source record against its exact Git commit, path, SHA-256, and line range.
Verify every WID, route identity, canonical public path, and requirement identifier appears exactly once in its expected index.
Verify definition owners and every re-export destination resolve to source-bound inventory rows.
Verify all required behavior cases are present as proposed/not-approved and remain NOT VERIFIED.
Verify all historical JSONL rows, lane/disposition totals, stable IDs, and source-row hashes.
Verify RETIRE decisions match the source symbol, T37 decision scope, artifact hash, and approved cleanup.
Run the five accepted in-memory missing-export controls and record each expected/actual blocker.
limits: This checker validates static inventory data and source identities only.
No product source, tests, harnesses, fixtures, doctests, Cargo commands, or test plans are changed or executed.
Selected behavior cases remain zero; product behavior remains NOT VERIFIED.
The checker does not claim rustc-resolved feature reachability or prove behavior.

contract_review.scope: Aggregate schema, join/index contract, source-binding rules, disposition rules, and accepted in-memory negative-control specification only.
limits: This review does not accept any worker fragment or the final requirements.json.
This review does not approve a T38 plan or product behavior.
Selected behavior cases remain zero and product behavior remains NOT VERIFIED.
